title: One org language authority: new teams inherit it, team overrides are explicit
deviations_from_card: (1) Acceptance 3 vs flow step 4 conflict resolved in favour of the acceptance: setOrganizationLocale does NOT clear overrides by default (teamB keeps 'en' across an org change); it takes { clearOverrides } and only setOrgLanguage (the Organization tab) passes true (acceptance 4). (2) The backfill copies stored values VERBATIM (a corrupt legacy 'zz' is stamped as override 'zz', which resolves to 'cs' exactly as before) instead of validating in core.ts - keeps i18n/locales off core.ts's every-route import graph; the resolver is the one validation point. (3) Write set grew by three existing tests that encoded the old storage, each updated to the new door and still pinning its intent: comms-locale.test.ts and comms-dispatch-locale.test.ts wrote workspaces.default_locale by raw SQL (now the override); core-empty-boot.test.ts asserted seed_marks is EMPTY on a blank tenant, now it forbids every fixture mark and allows exactly the one structural 'org-locale-authority' migration mark. (4) Shared surface: perf-budget.json job-ingest 408 -> 410 under the lock (own measured share). No tenancy.ts change (new column on an existing table).
notes: Critic ruling honoured and pinned: test 6 builds a pre-migration DB (column dropped, mark removed, org rows reset) with 7+ teams across two orgs in en/cs/de/fr/zz, reboots ensureDb, and asserts every team resolves exactly its pre-migration value; a second boot after setOrganizationLocale('de') keeps 'de' (one-shot via seed_marks 'org-locale-authority'). Acceptance 4 and 7 already held under the old fan-out (kept as regression pins), hence 5 of 7 red before. Backfill + setOrganizationLocale + clearWorkspaceLocaleOverride each run in one .immediate() transaction with no await. Gates: tsc whole-tree red ONLY on sibling in-flight paths (kpi-sim/ untracked copy, analytics/*, shell/simulation/*) - zero errors on my files; eslint on touched files 0; full npm run test:unit 10066/10066 green on the combined tree before the feat commit; docs:check 0; lint:ts-ratchet 0. Perf measured in a clean worktree: green at 8cfc592df~1, job-ingest 406 -> 410 after the feat (+4 KB, mine alone), fixed by the ab241738f ceiling raise; llm-config lands exactly at its 323 ceiling. At HEAD ab241738f test:perf is red on app/page.tsx (1399 modules / 8788 KB vs 1398 / 8774) - a client graph my server-store files are not on (green at 9ca3e9789); it comes from sibling commits landed after mine (shell-simulation-engine / github-repo-intelligence). Known gap documented: no per-team language UI; a language changed while rolled back to an older image (which writes only the legacy column) is not seen after re-upgrade.
